entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Thank you for taking the Big Bang[n]Challenge.

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: This is your first time, yes? Your[n]starting rank will be Third Mate.

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Thus, your aim will be... the Comet Burger!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is a lot bigger than I was expecting...

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: This burger is as voluminous as a soaring[n]comet burning in the sky. It will not be[n]overcome easily.

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: But should you conquer this challenge,[n]you will be rewarded with an extravagant[n]prize.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ooh, a prize would be great! Good luck,[n][fName]!

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Thank you for coming to take the Big[n]Bang Challenge once again.

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Since you are currently ranked at Third[n]Mate... this will be your opponent.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The Comet Burger looks as intensely[n]large as always...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, you have thirty minutes for this[n]battle. Good luck...

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Thank you for coming back for the Big[n]Bang Challenge.

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: As you have moved up to the rank of[n]Second Mate... this is your next foe!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Holy crap! It's humongous...

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: This is the Gravity Burger... A burger[n]so large that it almost has its own[n]gravitational field.

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Once again, this will be no easy feat[n]to overcome.

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: But should you conquer this challenge,[n]you will be rewarded with an extravagant[n]prize.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So this one comes with a prize too...[n]Do your best, [fName]!

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Thank you for coming again! Please do[n]your best to complete your objective,[n]Second Mate.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is it... The Gravity Burger...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Keep yourself fully focused for the next[n]thirty minutes!

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Thank you for taking the Big Bang[n]Challenge again.

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: This is the final task before you can[n]ascend to the rank of Captain.

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Our store's behemoth burger stands[n]in your way! A meal of leviathan[n]proportions...

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: The Cosmic Tower Burger!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's massive... I'm honestly at a loss[n]for words...

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: This burger is the ultimate embodiment[n]of the limitless nature of space!

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: The volume... the flavor... the calories...[n]Every aspect of this burger is astronomical!

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: If you can succeed at eating the entire[n]thing, you'll be presented with an[n]extraordinary gift.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I wonder if anyone's ever actually[n]finished it...

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Thank you for coming back to attempt[n]the final mission again!

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: This will be your foe!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There it is... The Cosmic Tower Burger...[n]It's as daunting as always...

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Thank you for taking the Big Bang[n]Challenge!

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Your opponent is once again ready and[n]waiting for you!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The Cosmic Tower Burger... Its grandeur[n]overwhelms me no matter how many[n]times I see it...

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Well then, it's time to get the thirty-minute[n]Big Bang Challenge started! Ready...
entries.uk: Отже, час розпочати тридцятихвилинний[n]Челендж «Біг Бенг»! Приготувалися...

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Go!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The way you eat is so impressive...

entries.speaker: Female Employee
entries.en: Your defeat is quite unfortunate, but[n]I hope to see you come back for our[n]challenge again!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, we should head home.[n]I'm full just from watching you...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, why don't we head home?[n]I'm all hungry now...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, why don't we head home?[n]I'm all hungry now...
